SLIMEBOSS-COMMAND.title: Command
SLIMEBOSS-COMMAND.description: Trigger the effect of the specified Slimes.
SLIMEBOSS-CONSUME.title: Consume
SLIMEBOSS-CONSUME.description: Bonus effect. If the target has [gold]Weak[/gold], remove a stack and trigger the effect.
SLIMEBOSS-SPLIT.title: Split
SLIMEBOSS-SPLIT.description: Summon a Slime. If you already have it, it gains [gold]Potency[/gold] equal to its effect amount instead.
